method: Order by complete constraint-graph degree then global index, including the independently justified cog-cap clique. Remove b only for earlier retained same-family adjacent a with N(a) minus b contained in N(b), and compatible-groups(b) a subset of compatible-groups(a). Keep all unprocessed candidates on either bound. Independently enumerate every certificate neighbor, map all 30 exact original 64-part seeds with quantity and full-graph checks, then seed the exact derived cog clique and compress the induced graph by first-fit lowest-index clique expansion. The20-second compression timer includes the seeded clique. Preserve every residual edge after the 20-second compression limit; independently reconstruct the entire final graph from all cliques and residual edges.
